name: Escape from the Group Project
desc1: The deadline is in sixty minutes and somebody has to carry the team. Piece together who did what before the final submission locks you out.
desc2: Navigate through endless passive-aggressive Slack messages and scrambled slide decks to assemble the final presentation before your grade drops to zero.
tagline: Five teammates. One deliverable. Zero contributions.
alt: Group project members looking bored and listless in a library where they are supposed to be finishing their project

name: The Endless Meeting
desc1: Trapped in a calendar invite that keeps getting extended, you must crack the cipher hidden within redundant status updates to find the exit door.
desc2: Fight off sleep and corporate buzzwords as you race against the clock to escape a sync that could have literally been an async Slack chat.
tagline: This could have been an email.
alt: A bland conference room where boredom reigns and dreams go to die

name: The Unhandled Exception
desc1: A critical system crash has locked you inside the core server rack. Trace the corrupted stack trace to patch the vulnerability before the system melts down.
desc2: Navigate a labyrinth of cascading null pointer exceptions and endless error logs to debug your way back to safety.
alt: Stack traces and massive binders of documentation stand between these folks and freedom from this chaotic room

name: Deploy to Production on Friday
desc1: You pushed code to main right before clocking out for the weekend. Now you have to reverse-engineer a flawless deployment script while alarms blare all around you.
desc2: Tackle frantic pipeline failures and broken CI/CD builds before Monday morning standup exposes your fatal mistake.
alt: Teammates try desperately to roll back the deployment before the entire system crashes

name: The Legacy Codebase
desc1: Venturing deep into undocumented software written back in 1988, you must decipher cryptic functions and ancient spaghetti code to find the master key.
desc2: Explore dusty directories and unravel layer upon layer of technical debt to uncover the original developer's escape hatch.
alt: A dimly-lit basement server room showing years of poor cable management and probably a FORTRAN 77 manual or two

name: Merge Conflict
desc1: You and your rival are trapped on opposite branches of a split repository. Resolve the conflicting code lines to merge your paths back together.
desc2: Survive a barrage of competing git pulls, detached heads, and force-push disasters to clear the staging area.
alt: A room split between two git branch diagrams with more than a few conflicts to be resolved

name: Time Warp
desc1: A catastrophic timezone mismatch has thrown you completely out of sync with the universe. Reset the atomic clocks before you're stuck in an infinite loop forever.
desc2: Jump across broken epoch timestamps and daylight saving time anomalies to restore the chronological order of reality.
tagline: Bend time or get left behind.
alt: Teammates try to restore order to the temporal nexus by unraveling disastrous mismatches due to daylight saving time
